note: Never-use libc names (every project source), currently grep includes declarations/comments.
Restricted libc calls permitted only within resolved cbase directory.

diagnostic: use #if defined or #if !defined
note: Ban #ifdef and #ifndef; includes Ryu.

diagnostic: use SIZEOF instead of sizeof
note: Ban builtin sizeof outside Ryu and macro definition of SIZEOF.

diagnostic: tab character is forbidden
note: All files including Ryu.

diagnostic: trailing whitespace
note: All files including Ryu.

diagnostic: line exceeds \d+ columns
note: 80 Unicode columns; 100 for cecup/src; no column limit for piscou config.h.

diagnostic: use a block comment after #endif
note: Only Ryu: block instead of // after #endif.

diagnostic: missing final newline
note: Only Ryu; other project files not checked.

diagnostic: \b(?:if|else|for|while|switch|do) body must use curly braces
note: All except Ryu; allows else if and empty for body.

diagnostic: only one variable declaration per line
note: All except Ryu; catches comma declarators and multiple declarations per physical line.

diagnostic: (?:case|default) must align with switch
note: All except Ryu; nearest enclosing switch.

diagnostic: artificial block at nesting level 3 or more is forbidden
note: All except Ryu; limited to 12+ space indentation, excludes initializer and control headers.

diagnostic: call breaks before the first argument
note: Not .meta.h; indented candidate calls only.

diagnostic: function header parameter is not aligned with first parameter
note: Not .meta.h; two-line unindented return-type/function-name convention.

diagnostic: call string literal is not aligned with first literal
note: Not .meta.h.

diagnostic: call argument is not aligned with its alignment anchor
note: Not .meta.h; percent-containing format literal selects anchor.

diagnostic: format-string line must contain all format arguments or none
note: Not .meta.h.

diagnostic: related (?:_len|x/y|width/height) arguments must be the only arguments on their lines
note: Not .meta.h; pairs with other args must be kept together or isolated.

diagnostic: call fits on one line but is split across multiple lines
note: Not .meta.h; considers adjacent same-indent groups, comments and literals.

diagnostic: assignment = must end the preceding line
note: Except Ryu and .meta.h; do not conflate comparison ==.

diagnostic: assignment fits on one line but is split after =
note: Except Ryu and .meta.h; groups related adjacent assignments.

diagnostic: use ASSERT_(?:GE|GT|LE|LT) for comparison with integers
note: Regex of ASSERT(identifier rel-op integer); script does not explicitly exclude Ryu.

diagnostic: use ASSERT_BETWEEN\(
note: Adjacent ASSERT_GE(v, 0) and ASSERT_LT(v, upper); except Ryu.

diagnostic: STRLIT_LEN called on a literal string
note: STRLIT_LEN("...") redundant.

diagnostic: STREQUAL called with STRLIT literal
note: Prefer direct literal usage without STRLIT wrapper.

diagnostic: single-argument format string without literal content
note: str_printf with format-only % conversion.

diagnostic: inline the int32 status assignment/use pairs
note: Function-local int32 status; adjacent one-line assign/use pairs.

diagnostic: ternary operator is forbidden
note: check_ternary_operators is implemented but invocation commented out.
c-format.md forbids spaces around binary *, but legacy checker does not enforce it.
Some format recommendations about commas are not enforced; confirm policy before implementing.
